nodes.natural_language: Determine all possible values of $S = \frac{a}{a+b+d}+\frac{b}{a+b+c}+\frac{c}{b+c+d}+\frac{d}{a+c+d}$ where $a, b, c, d,$ are arbitrary positive numbers.
